Before you create your OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline, complete the following steps:
1. Prepare credentials for your Jira site by choosing one of the following options. OpenSearch
Ingestion requires only ReadOnly authorization to the content.
a. Option 1: API key – Log in to your Atlassian account and use the information in the following
topic to generate your API key:
• Manage API tokens for your Atlassian account
b. Option 2: OAuth2 – Log in to your Atlassian account and use the information in the section
called “Connecting an Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline to Atlassian Jira or Conﬂuence
using OAuth 2.0”.
2. Create a secret in AWS Secrets Manager to store the credentials created in the previous step.
Make the following choices as you follow the procedure:
• For Secret type, choose Other type of secret.
• For Key/value pairs, create the following pairs, depending on your selected authorization
type:
API key
{
"username": user-name-usualy-email-id,
"password": api-key
}
OAuth 2.0
{
"clientId": client-id
"clientSecret": client-secret
"accessKey": access-key
"refreshKey": refresh-key
}
Atlassian Services
105
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
After you've created the secret, copy the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the secret. You will
include it in the pipeline role permissions policy.
